faq_section.title: Invoice Automation — questions and answers
faq_section.subtitle: Practical answers before we discuss your project.

questions.question: Which invoice formats can you work with?
questions.answer: We assess your sample PDFs, scans and other files first. Supported formats and extraction reliability depend on the document-processing tool and invoice quality.

questions.question: Can this connect to QuickBooks or our ERP?
questions.answer: We review the specific product, API access and required accounting fields before confirming scope. Desktop and cloud products can have different integration constraints.

questions.question: Will invoices be posted or paid automatically?
questions.answer: Only actions explicitly agreed in your workflow are automated. Human approval can be required before accounting entries or other consequential actions.

questions.question: What happens when extraction is uncertain?
questions.answer: The workflow flags the invoice for review, preserves the original document and records the correction or exception rather than silently accepting uncertain values.
